about: A Navi chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3; docs/multirom/chips-code.md, the Navi chips past nine bits): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan with a folder of one LarkMan S and 29 Cannon A in both games, the LarkMan dealt first (a Mega chip: a folder of them alone never deals), BN5's chip 272 by BN5's own code and the registry's 518 by the same code moved (BN5's Navi routine 0x11 as BN6's 0x2e: his battle sprite BN5's own, list 2's 0x11, LZ77 there and queued, copied whole at a number of the chips' in BN6's list 2; his attack's objects, the third kind's 0xBA, 0xC7 and 0xCB, moved with it), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md).
